about: Curated port status for docs/items.md. Ids, names, kinds and pools come from the game's items.xml/itempools.xml; active status comes from docs/active-items.md. Edit this file, then run `npm run items:update`. status: missing (no item-specific behaviour), partial (some behaviour or no passing live case), complete (every behaviour ported and the named live case passes). Never mark a failing or unrun comparison complete.

mechanisms.name: Familiar and orbital composition
mechanisms.note: Leech only; no orbitals. All 69 Familiar actors are imported at build time (`npm run assets:items`).

mechanisms.name: Costumes
mechanisms.note: One path for every collectible (wardrobe.rs): the costumes2.xml row of the same id (passive, active or familiar) registers, 50EDC0 assigns the 13 Player layer slots by layer name and priority with skin colours (hasSkinAlt sheets), head and body entries follow the Player clips, and Brimstone and Monstro's Lung drive theirs through 508820. Magic Mushroom (Player+2C4 x1.25) and Odd Mushroom (head layers x1.1/x0.9) scale the sprite. Footage of sets 1+4+12, 120, 14+32+74, 8+46+101 and 3+70+121 against a Gaper shows matching costumes and size; the rest of each case (the fight, #946) still mismatches. Not ported: costume removal, null and transformation costumes, the flight body-group swap beyond isFlying, co-op.
